patterns.name: Versioned changelog drop
patterns.why_it_travels: A version number plus bullets of new commands. Builders bookmark and try one.
examples: mattpocockuk: AI Coding Crash Course link (~16k)

patterns.name: Prompt of the day that mines your own history
patterns.why_it_travels: Copy-paste recipe that turns past work into rules. Saves and bookmarks.

patterns.name: Broken metric + data receipt + tool that fixes it
patterns.why_it_travels: Outrage at a trusted number, backed by a chart, then a shipped fix. Quotes pile on.

patterns.name: Shipped a small filter/feature same day
patterns.why_it_travels: Reply-driven feature shipped in hours. Shows speed.

patterns.name: Re-run an old experiment on a new local model
patterns.why_it_travels: Credible before/after with credit to the original author.

patterns.name: Agent sprawl confession
patterns.why_it_travels: Relatable overload with concrete counts. Everyone has 40 tabs.
examples: clairevo: 40 bots, a million Codex threads (~12k)

patterns.name: AI video quality praise
patterns.why_it_travels: Short verdict on a new model's video output.

patterns.name: Off-topic lifestyle/health bait
patterns.why_it_travels: Huge reach, zero AI receipt. Skip for @bobbyships.
